atlas_home_region_card.compact: Detroit machine futurism: precise pulse, synthetic space, and underground imagination.
atlas_home_region_card.standard: It gave global club culture a new template for producer identity, minimal structure, and machine emotion.
atlas_home_region_card.deep: Detroit machine futurism: precise pulse, synthetic space, and underground imagination. It gave global club culture a new template for producer identity, minimal structure, and machine emotion.

region_scene_page.compact: Techno emerged in Detroit as electronic dance music that treated machines as vehicles for futurism, repetition, and post-industrial feeling.
region_scene_page.standard: Detroit techno starts with machine funk, sequenced synths, and futurist minimalism, then branches outward into global club languages. Juan Atkins, Kevin Saunderson, Inner City, and Jeff Mills give the scene its Detroit landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Detroit techno starts with machine funk, sequenced synths, and futurist minimalism, then branches outward into global club languages. Juan Atkins, Kevin Saunderson, Inner City, and Jeff Mills give the scene its Detroit landmarks. Nearby UK and European tracks remain useful as outward branches, not as the origin story.
